subject: Draft MAP & dependencies for ClinicalEdge pilot — target close June 30
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: James Ross <j.ross@clinicaledge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & dependencies for ClinicalEdge pilot — target close June 30

Hi James — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached v1.1):

Summary of outcome:
- ClinicalEdge confirmed interest in a 6-week pilot focused on inference latency and cost-per-token for batch document summarization.
- Key stakeholders: James Ross (Clinical lead), procurement (TBD), security (Matt Riley), and product (A. Chen).

Proposed high-level milestones (MAP v1.1):
1) Kickoff & SOW finalization — target: Apr 22 — Owner: ClinicalEdge (procurement) + Redwood (Lauren)
2) Trial environment & credentials — target: Apr 29 — Owner: Redwood (Ben)
3) Baseline benchmarking (3 workloads) — target: May 13 — Owner: ClinicalEdge + Redwood
4) Quality review & minor tuning — target: May 27 — Owner: Redwood + ClinicalEdge PM
5) Pilot close & go/no-go decision — target: Jun 30 — Owner: ClinicalEdge execs

Dependencies / blockers:
- ClinicalEdge needs to confirm SSO approach and whether they will provide service account credentials for test data access (security asked).
- Procurement needs a short SOW and terms preview (I attached a terms preview).

Immediate next steps (for this week):
- James: confirm procurement contact and estimated procurement timeline (by Wed Apr 14).
- Ben: will prep trial environment and share test credentials once we have confirmation on SSO vs service account.
- Rishi: I looped you on pricing comps; will expect your note if we should propose a trial credit package.

Attachments: ClinicalEdge_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (draft MAP), redwood-terms-preview.pdf (terms snapshot)

Thanks — I will update the MAP based on your procurement timelines and security ask.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142
From: James Ross <j.ross@clinicaledge.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClinicalEdge Procurement <procurement@clinicaledge.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & dependencies for ClinicalEdge pilot — target close June 30

Thanks Lauren — good summary. A couple of quick clarifying Qs: 
1) Security: our security lead Matt flagged that we need a SOC 2 / data flow description before providing service account access. Can Redwood provide the SOC 2 report and a short data flow diagram?
2) Procurement: I added procurement on CC — they typically take 2–3 weeks to review SOW/terms. Can you provide a one-page SOW version for their review?

If procurement can move that quickly we should still be on track for your April 22 SOW milestone.

-James
James Ross
Head of Product, ClinicalEdge
j.ross@clinicaledge.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: James Ross <j.ross@clinicaledge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ClinicalEdge Procurement <procurement@clinicaledge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & dependencies for ClinicalEdge pilot — target close June 30

James — appreciate the quick turnaround. Notes below and I attached MAP v1.2 plus a one-page SOW.

Security/SOC2:
- Attached is the latest SOC 2 type II summary + a short data flow sketch. If Matt needs the full report we can start an NDA-driven exchange; otherwise the summary should help procurement/security triage.

MAP updates (v1.2 highlights):
- Added SOC2 evidence checkpoint: Redwood to provide SOC2 summary by Apr 16; ClinicalEdge to indicate if they require full report by Apr 23.
- Clarified owners: Ben will own trial environment provisioning and the test-case pack.
- Adjusted milestone dates: moved trial environment target to Apr 30 to give procurement a week to review SOW.
- Added acceptance criteria for the baseline benchmark (latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, and inference correctness checks).

Ben — can you confirm you can provision the test environment and include a short test plan by Apr 22?
Rishi — recommendation on trial credit: are we ok offering a $10k trial credit for this 6-week pilot? Can you confirm by EOD Apr 16?

Attachments: ClinicalEdge_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, ClinicalEdge_onepage_SOW.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-terms-preview.pdf

On a process note — I updated the HubSpot record (link below) and included the MAP milestone checklist as a task list.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/89012345
Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2B3cMapDraft/view

Best,
Lauren

Subject: ClinicalEdge MAP — weekly checkpoint and overdue items (resend attachments)

Hi James / procurement team — quick weekly checkpoint on the MAP and a gentle nudge on outstanding items so we don't slip the pilot runway.

Current status (from MAP v1.2):
- SOW one-pager: submitted (Lauren) — action: procurement to confirm by Apr 22 (OVERDUE/awaiting response)
- SOC2 summary: provided (Lauren) — action: ClinicalEdge security to confirm whether full report needed by Apr 23 (OPEN)
- Trial environment & test plan: in progress (Ben) — Ben to confirm credentials ETA Apr 22
- Trial credit approval: pending (Rishi) — Rishi to confirm if $10k trial credit is approved by EOD Apr 16 (OVERDUE)

Ask for this week: please confirm owners and ETA for the two procurement/security items so we can lock the kickoff date. If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a 20-min call with Matt + procurement to walk through the SOC2 summary and the SOW.

Resending attachments: ClinicalEdge_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, ClinicalEdge_onepage_SOW.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-terms-preview.pdf

If I don't hear back by Wednesday Apr 21 I'll schedule a short check-in call for Thu Apr 22.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
